definitions.explanation: Describes a tendency to focus on internal matters rather than engaging with the outside world. Used for personalities, organizations, or national policies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{内向|うちむ}きな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧だ。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{内向|うちむ}きになっている⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that young people in Japan are becoming more inward-looking.

examples.japanese: {内向|うちむ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦{競争力|きょうそうりょく}→競争力：27066_kyousouryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: If we only pursue inward-looking policies, our international competitiveness will decline.

notes:
Used both for personal disposition (introverted, shy) and for broader tendencies in organizations or nations (domestically focused, isolationist). Often contrasted with ⟦{外向|そとむ}き→外向き：26800_sotomuki⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内向|うちむ}きな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: introverted personality
- {内向|うちむ}きな⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: inward-looking stance
- {内向|うちむ}き⟦{志向|しこう}→志向：12607_shikou⟧: inward-oriented tendency

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{内向的|ないこうてき}→内向的：08458_naikouteki⟧: introverted — specifically for personality; more psychological
- ⟦{外向|そとむ}き→外向き：26800_sotomuki⟧: outward-looking — the direct opposite
- ⟦{消極的|しょうきょくてき}→消極的：04779_shoukyokuteki⟧: passive; negative — implies reluctance to act, not necessarily inward focus
